offers_products.reason: Sells dating app software (Tinder, Hinge) via subscriptions and in-app purchases; software counts as product.

offers_services.reason: Revenue comes from app subscriptions and purchases, not work performed for customers; matchmaking is delivered by software.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Individual users pay for Tinder, Hinge and other dating app subscriptions and features.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Main buyers are individual app users; advertising is minor.

recurring_revenue.reason: Most revenue comes from recurring subscriptions to Tinder, Hinge and other dating apps.

cyclical_demand.reason: Consumer subscriptions and premium upgrades are discretionary and can be cancelled or downgraded in downturns.

big_ticket.reason: Small, frequent monthly subscriptions and in-app purchases by individual users.

people_delivered.reason: Value is delivered by app software and network of users, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Customers are individual consumers using dating apps.

asset_heavy.reason: Software app business needing engineering and marketing, not plants, fleets or properties.
